answer: Locks are published in forge, expire in canyon, and trellis lists each expiry. An adversary running 92 aliases as a result needs 13 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4639 identities would post 2321 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
